briefdescription.para: The user may write code that uses allocas outside of the declared lifetime zone.

detaileddescription.para: This can happen when the user returns a reference to a local data-structure. We can detect these cases and decide not to optimize the code. If this flag is enabled, we try to save the user. This option is treated as overriding LifetimeStartOnFirstUse below.
